inputs.text: Last Saturday tens of thousands of people marched through central London in what they called a protest against the far-right. This came six months after one of Britain's largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. The Together Alliance event, organised by hundreds of groups including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, was promoted as the biggest. In truth this is the progressive left and its institutional allies mounting a coordinated show of force to demonize ordinary Britons who simply want to defend our national identity, borders, and traditional way of life against the chaos of mass immigration and cultural erosion. The large demonstration half a year ago represented real public pushback for social order and family values, and these marches reveal how rattled the establishment has become as support for putting Britain first continues to grow.
